bounds_rule: u in +/-rho/0.02; unbounded +/-Inf; global frequency constraints preserved
SMR_start_rule: fixed radius 0.02 and |u|<=1 for all radii
trigger_definition: At 20 Hz on [5,T-5), |B(t)u|>=0.95 B(t)m; longest maximal contiguous run, samples/20 seconds
candidate_selection: Explicit previous solution and feasible stage endpoints; maximum final full-length objective J only; no eta or observed peak

bootstrap.unit: seed cluster within scene; all seven SNR records carried together

D1.reason: All four 95%/nonpositive-gain conditions met; largest eligible spacing.
D1.selection_uses: eta gain vs common VIT, point estimates; peak not used

ADA_selection.rule: G >= 0.9 Gref; H <= Hmin+0.005; global, smaller cap, larger tau.

reproducibility_recipe.bootstrap_sampling: Two scene-stratified seed-cluster draw arrays, 2000 x 60 each, generated sequentially with seed 20261051 and reused across paired metrics/variants; all 7 SNR records carried together.

output_only_pre_D2_changes: phaseD_d2_one.m: fixed-radius dwell diagnostics use their actual bounds; UNB not applicable
plot_phaseD_dev.py: equivalent explicit PDF/SVG/PNG export for static audit
provenance.runtime_definition: Six-worker loaded wall time of each BTA optimizer call. ADA sums reused F02 call time plus expansion call times; excludes frontend, family/SMR construction and dwell bookkeeping. This is not a serial benchmark.

figure_export.display_only_correction: Peak figure subplot top 0.84 -> 0.76; no data or decision changes; numerical source manifest unchanged.

equivalent_reuse.authority: Main protocol section 2.7 permits efficient implementations with identical per-record results
equivalent_reuse.fixed: F02 and UNB at selected Delta copied exactly from D1, with input-hash and SMR-start equality assertions
equivalent_reuse.global_grid: Compute tau=10 cap=0.08 chain once; retain the exact allowed prefix for each larger tau and cap
equivalent_reuse.local_grid: Compute separate cap=0.08 chain for each tau; cap=0.04 is its first-round prefix
equivalent_reuse.timing: Sum only the saved call times in the selected prefix, including the common F02 solve
